description: Consensus parameters of a ZcashHeaderRelay that follows Zcash Testnet (script/DeployRelay.s.sol, RELAY_NETWORK=testnet). Every value is verified in docs/ref/FACTS.md (Zebra v7.0.0-rc.0, ZIP 218, ZIP 259) and documented on ZcashHeaderRelay.RelayParams; test/relay/ZcashHeaderRelayParams.t.sol checks that this file parses to the parameters the Testnet tests use.

notes.powLimit: PoWLimit = 2^251 - 1, rounded through its compact form 0x2007ffff
notes.minDifficultyBlocks: a block more than 450 s after its parent (6 x 75 s before NU7, 18 x 25 s from NU7) must carry powLimitBits
notes.minCheckpointHeight: the 90-minute rule starts at 653,606; Blossom (75 s spacing) at 584,000
